jobs.title: Vice President Controlling and Finance PSN
jobs.description:
VICE PRESIDENT CONTROLLING & FINANCE – Parts & Services NASA

Are you a driven leader who sets ambitious targets and thrives on transforming a business? Do you combine strong financial acumen with a close-to-the-business approach? Are you passionate about developing a healthy, high-performing culture focused on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collaboration?

Our Parts and Service Division in NASA is looking for an experienced Vice President of Controlling and Finance to support business management and deliver focused, accurate reporting that strengthens commercial competence and financial control across the region.

About The Role

As Vice President of Controlling and Finance, you will ensure the delivery of quality-assured and timely financial and non-financial data. This will enable the division to understand its performance against agreed targets, analyze deviations, and proactively implement corrective actions.

In this role, you will be a pivotal member of the divisional management team, participate in business development activities, drive efficiency, and actively contribute to the development of the business in line with our strategy for growth. You will also foster an organization where innovative and efficient people thrive and flourish.

You will be a member of several legal and operational boards within the division’s administrative entities, as well as the Epiroc Financial Council. In this capacity, you will actively contribute to the development of finance and business control practices across the Group.

This is a key position reporting directly to the President of the Parts and Service NASA Division, with a strong connection to the Business Area Controller.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure control over the division’s consolidated financial performance and verify that financial reporting and accounting practices comply with company policies and local regulations.
Gather and present high-quality financial and business data to support strategic decision-making at all levels of the division.
Take ownership of working capital management, proactively reduce overdue payments with the VPs of Marketing and Operations and global functions such as Supply Chain, and establish inventory targets for Customer Centers and regional teams.
Develop a deep understanding of the Parts and Service and supply chain businesses, and advise managers on business cases, investment alternatives, and company valuations.
Lead regional budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, ensuring alignment between financial targets, business assumptions, and strategic priorities.
Actively challenge and support PSD Global Capabilities on financial planning, return on investment, and capability development.
Continuously monitor and analyze business performance, including active participation in review meetings for Customer Centers, Global Hubs, Supply Chain, and Business Areas.
Identify and interpret business trends, highlight potential risks, and ensure that appropriate action plans are developed and implemented.
Design and deliver tools that provide early warnings of deviations and enable accurate forecasting, helping management avoid unexpected outcomes.
Promote consistent adherence to The Epiroc Way and lead internal and external audit activities, ensuring corrective action is taken when required.
Support strategic acquisitions by coordinating due diligence, developing valuation models, and overseeing financial integration and post-acquisition follow-up.
Provide strong financial leadership and support to the Alternative Offering Business Line, helping establish and develop the new leadership structure, financial governance, and ways of working in alignment with The Epiroc Way.
Build and lead a professional, high-performing finance organization, while strengthening collaboration, team spirit, and financial capabilities across the region.

Experience And Requirements

Strong background as a customer center and product company Business Controller with proven track of delivering results, and of developing a successful, well-motivated organization.
Capability in business process management, and a solid business understanding and interest.
Solid knowledge of financial consolidation/reporting systems.
Experience working in a global organization with multiple factories, distribution centers, and customer markets, including experience from being a manager in a complex international matrix organization and being exposed to corporate risk management.
University degree in finance and/or business administration or similar, relevant field.
Fluency in English is required, both written and verbally. Additional languages are a plus.

Location and travel

Location in an Epiroc office in NASA:

Dallas, US

Belo Horizonte, Brazil

Mexico DF, Mexico

Lima, Peru

Mississauga, Canada

Up to 25% of international travel expected

Recruitment Process

Please send your application through our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 2026.11.27
. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media
.

Epiroc provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, national origin, ethnic background, age, disability, political opinion, social status, veteran status, union membership or genetics.

Epiroc complies with applicable country, state, and all local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location across the world in which the company has facilities. In addition, Epiroc supports the UN Guiding Principles for Business and Human Rights and the United Nations Global Compact.

It all starts with people.
The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Product Management

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a product leader who can turn a strategic product vision into shipped reality at scale. As Senior Director, AI Product Management, you will own user-focused product success for RBC's internal Agentic AI platform, defining the product vision and translating it into a tangible roadmap, community, and ecosystem. You will build discipline around ensuring relentless customer focus and a business-strategy lens on what we build and why. You will lead a team of Product Managers and own Voice of the Customer, feature prioritization, adoption and community building around the product across RBC.

You will be expected to set the operating rhythm, make the hard tradeoff and resourcing calls, and hold a quality bar — bringing the credibility that comes from having built and shipped AI products at scale, not just managed roadmaps.

Your responsibilities will include:

Team leadership: Leading and developing Director-level leads (across Product Strategy & Roadmap, Community & Adoption, Ecosystem & Partnerships) and the teams beneath them, with clear career paths and succession
Integrated delivery: Owning a single execution plan that aligns roadmap delivery, community programs, and partnership milestones to one cadence
Operating cadence: Establishing and running sprint reviews, quarterly planning, and OKR setting and tracking
Tradeoff and escalation ownership: Serving as the primary escalation point for cross-pillar dependencies, tradeoffs, and resourcing decisions
Product quality: Maintaining acceptance criteria, release gates, and documentation standards across the squad
Adoption and outcomes: Using analytics, telemetry, and adoption measurement to drive decisions and report progress, risks, and resource needs
Ecosystem health: Ensuring the community and partnership programs sustain engagement and healthy adoption across the RBC user base

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading multi-team product organizations as a manager of managers
Have a track record of customer discovery and translating user needs into product strategy and prioritization
Have hands-on experience delivering end-user facing AI products — ideally generative or agentic AI — at production scale
Have run large-scale internal or enterprise product launches with measurable adoption outcomes
Bring strong operational discipline: agile delivery, OKR frameworks, and release management
Are data-driven, comfortable with analytics, telemetry, and adoption metrics as the basis for product decisions
Have financial services experience, or the ability to rapidly develop it - understanding how banking employees work and the regulatory constraints on internal tooling
Have a working knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, or RAG architecture — sufficient to shape product decisions and engage technical teams

Nice to have:

MBA or Master's in a technical or business discipline
Product management certification (CSPO, SAFe, AIPM, or Pragmatic Institute)
Background in platform engineering or developer experience teams
Experience in a major bank's technology or digital transformation function

What's in it for you:

Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC
Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment

RBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodations during the application process are available upon request.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Finance Systems
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact

As Senior Director, Finance Systems within OpenText’s CDO organization, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how technology enables Finance at a global scale. This is a highly visible leadership role where you’ll lead functional and technical teams responsible for Finance systems delivery, operations, and modernization, including SAP on-premises applications and integrated services.

You’ll help drive OpenText’s Finance modernization agenda, including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud, while partnering with senior Finance and IT leaders to turn business priorities into technology outcomes. You’ll lead through complexity, leverage AI and emerging technologies, and deliver measurable value for Finance teams and business users globally.

What You Will Do

Work closely with senior leaders to understand business objectives and develop the finance systems roadmap.
Responsible for leading the team in the delivery, operational support and continuous improvement of the SAP on-premises applications.
Finance modernization including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud capabilities and the broader ecosystem of solutions integrated into SAP
Work with Architecture and rest of the peer network to develop and maintain Financial Systems Landscape relevance.
Accountable for delivery of change & bug-fixes for all finance Systems
Accountable for the operational upkeep of the finance systems including SOX and other IT general controls.
Accountable for people agenda for the finance systems team.
Key contributor to the overall technology delivery strategy, ensuring the realization of goals such as reuse, infrastructure simplification, cost management, solution flexibility, operational resilience and the practical use of emerging technologies, including AI, to solve outcome-driven business and IT use cases.
Build strong cross-organizational relationships and effectively influence staff across the business and IT.

What You Are Great At

Building strong relationships and effectively managing expectations with senior stakeholders, business partners, peers, and external vendors.
Breaking down complex business problems into practical technology solutions, including automation and AI, to deliver measurable business and IT outcomes.
Leading effectively in a global operating model, with teams distributed across geographies and organizational structures.
Communicating complex technical and business concepts clearly and effectively to leadership and diverse audiences.
Thinking strategically and critically, developing roadmaps, and translating strategy into execution.
Managing multiple priorities, plans, and budgets in a fast-paced environment while delivering on time and on budget.
Driving best practices, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a culture of learning across teams.
Building and motivating high-performing teams and fostering an environment of trust, collaboration, and accountability.

What It Takes To Excel

10+ years of experience leading engineering, development, or technology delivery teams.
Strong experience leading complex SAP ERP delivery and operations, including SAP on-premises platforms and integrated Finance systems.
Proven experience leading S/4HANA Cloud implementations, including program delivery, business process transformation, stakeholder alignment, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
Strong understanding of complementary financial systems and cross-domain technology ecosystems, including Finance, HR, and CRM.
Experience supporting technology integrations related to Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures (M&A).
Experience leading multiple complex workstreams within a global organization.
High-tech software or technology services industry experience is an asset.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, college diploma, or equivalent experience.

One Last Thing:
If you’re a strategic technology leader who thrives on transformation, enjoys solving complex business challenges, and wants to shape the future of Finance technology at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Directeur Financier | Finance Director
jobs.description:
Description

Qui sommes-nous : Manos

Manos Software Group fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un investisseur à long terme dans les entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux. Valsoft acquiert et exploite des sociétés de logiciels avec une vision de détention permanente, en mettant l’accent sur l’autonomie, une croissance disciplinée et la création de valeur à long terme. Manos se concentre sur des secteurs connexes à la santé, notamment les logiciels dentaires, médicaux et vétérinaires.

Description Du Poste

Dans le cadre de l’expansion continue de notre portefeuille d’entreprises de logiciels spécialisés par secteur d’activité, nous recherchons une personne dynamique et expérimentée pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Directeur.trice Financier·ère. Relevant directement de l’un des Partenaires d’Investissement, la personne retenue sera responsable de la supervision de la performance financière et du développement stratégique de notre portefeuille. Ce rôle implique une prise en charge complète de la planification financière, du reporting et de la gestion de la performance.

La personne idéale est un.e leader stratégique doté.e d’une forte expertise financière, capable de favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle, d’optimiser la rentabilité et d’assurer un flux de trésorerie positif. Cette personne travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, en favorisant la coopération pour exécuter avec succès les stratégies d’entreprise tout en maintenant des contrôles financiers rigoureux et une conformité exemplaire.

Responsabilités principales

Piloter la planification financière en analysant la performance et les risques du portefeuille
Définir les objectifs et superviser l’ensemble du personnel comptable et financier (comptabilité, FP&A, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs)
Préparer les rapports financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels
Élaborer et gérer les prévisions financières mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles ; suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs)
Surveiller et analyser les performances pour identifier des axes d’amélioration et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action permettant d’atteindre ou de dépasser les objectifs financiers
Suivre la santé financière du portefeuille et garantir un flux de trésorerie positif
Diriger et organiser les audits légaux annuels, en veillant au respect de toutes les obligations réglementaires
Développer des stratégies pour améliorer la rentabilité et le retour sur investissement
Superviser et réviser les activités comptables, y compris la fiscalité et la conformité
Veiller à l’efficacité des contrôles financiers internes et évaluer en continu les politiques et procédures en place
Collaborer avec l’équipe chargée de l’intégration des entreprises nouvellement acquises, notamment pour la production des bilans d’ouverture, des états financiers complets, et pour assurer leur intégration aux processus financiers de Valsoft
Maintenir une communication régulière avec le département Finance du groupe
Participer activement aux processus d’acquisition et de cession d’entreprises
Accomplir toutes autres responsabilités confiées par l’employeur, que la personne s’engage à exécuter avec diligence, conformément aux termes de l’accord

Prêt(e) à joindre une équipe collaborative et innovante où vous pourrez avoir un impact immédiat?

#Manos

Manos Overview

Manos Software Group is part of Valsoft Corporation, a long-term investor in vertical market software businesses. Valsoft acquires and operates software companies with a permanent ownership mindset, emphasizing autonomy, disciplined growth, and long-term value creation. Manos focuses on healthcare-adjacent verticals, including dental, medical, and veterinary software.

Position Description

As we continue to expand our portfolio of vertical market software businesses, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team as Finance Director. Reporting directly to one of our Investment Partners, the Finance Director will be responsible for overseeing the financial performance and strategic development of our portfolio. This role involves full ownership and accountability for financial planning, reporting, and performance management. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong financial acumen, capable of driving operational excellence, optimizing profitability, and ensuring positive cash flow. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration to execute business strategies successfully while maintaining rigorous financial controls and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the financial planning of the company by analyzing portfolio performance and risks
Set targets for and supervise all accounting and finance personnel (Accounting, FP&A, AR, AP)
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
Build and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts; track KPIs
Monitor and analyze performance strategies to identify areas of opportunity and implement action plans to meet or exceed financial targets
Monitor the financial health of the portfolio and ensure positive cash flow
Lead and organize annual statutory audits and ensure all required filings are completed
Develop strategies to increase return on investment and profitability
Oversee and review accounting tasks, including tax and compliance
Ensure effective financial internal controls and continuously evaluate established policies and procedures
Collaborate with the integration team of newly acquired companies by producing opening balances, complete financials, and onboarding on Valsoft finance procedures
Maintain high-level interaction with the corporate finance department
Actively participate in processes related to the sale or acquisition of companies
Perform all other applicable responsibilities as delegated by the Employer, which the Employee agrees to carry out diligently under the terms of the Agreement

Ready to join a collaborative and innovative team where you can make an immediate impact?

#Manos

Manos focuses on healthcare-adjacent verticals, including dental, medical, and veterinary software.

Position Description

As we continue to expand our portfolio of vertical market software businesses, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team as Finance Director. Reporting directly to one of our Investment Partners, the Finance Director will be responsible for overseeing the financial performance and strategic development of our portfolio. This role involves full ownership and accountability for financial planning, reporting, and performance management. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong financial acumen, capable of driving operational excellence, optimizing profitability, and ensuring positive cash flow. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration to execute business strategies successfully while maintaining rigorous financial controls and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the financial planning of the company by analyzing portfolio performance and risks
Set targets for and supervise all accounting and finance personnel (Accounting, FP&A, AR, AP)
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
Build and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts; track KPIs
Monitor and analyze performance strategies to identify areas of opportunity and implement action plans to meet or exceed financial targets
Monitor the financial health of the portfolio and ensure positive cash flow
Lead and organize annual statutory audits and ensure all required filings are completed
Develop strategies to increase return on investment and profitability
Oversee and review accounting tasks, including tax and compliance
Ensure effective financial internal controls and continuously evaluate established policies and procedures
Collaborate with the integration team of newly acquired companies by producing opening balances, complete financials, and onboarding on Valsoft finance procedures
Maintain high-level interaction with the corporate finance department
Actively participate in processes related to the sale or acquisition of companies
Perform all other applicable responsibilities as delegated by the Employer, which the Employee agrees to carry out diligently under the terms of the Agreement
